validation.scope: Saved aggregates, scene order, work counts, timings and prefix metrics; not an independent solver rerun.

metadata.solver: Contact-structured CFM: learned cross-contact rates, analytic projected coordinate endpoint, convex-combination Euler; not sequential PGS
metadata.selection_metric: group-balanced raw validation success, then PG residual

hybrid_settings.definition: Complete raw FM clock, then tolerance-stopped PGS on the same QP and exact FM endpoint; no reference input or fallback
hybrid_settings.timing: Primary: fresh continuous FM+handoff+PGS. Stage times: separate synchronized replays.
hybrid_settings.batch_policy: Same dense padded PGS implementation as baseline; solved rows get zero updates, no batch compaction
hybrid_settings.failures: Incomplete FM clocks are excluded from PGS and remain failed; PGS cap misses are explicit

timing.scope: Complete solver batch; excludes geometry, decode, labels and reporting. Per-QP time is amortized throughput, not single-QP latency.

cost.note: Counts, not FLOPs: NFE includes features/head/update; a PGS sweep sequentially visits all contacts. Padded counts include masked work.
